issues.on_page: Capital outlay 24,485 (General Fund column; no function on the row, its heading or the fund column)
issues.issue: Capital outlay rule: a function goes on the label only when it is printed on the row, its heading or a fund column that clearly names it. Here it comes from another statement (Statement of Activities p2 / budget schedule p8: Environment and leisure 36,660 = 12,175 + 24,485). That tie holds, but the rule doesn't allow it as a source. Fix: label 'Capital Outlay' with no function, or have a person approve the Statement of Activities source. Same for detail[8].
issues.resolved: label set to plain Capital Outlay (function not printed)
